faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits HP Pavilion X360 13-A series and Envy X360 15-U series (also Pavilion 13-b series). Note NP03XL is not interchangeable with the similarly-shaped BI03XL or ON03XL used on the newer Pavilion X360 13-U — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible battery?
faqs.answer: This is a genuine original HP NP03XL unit.
